input: Set up a weekly family game night

gold.taskTitle: Set Up a Weekly Family Game Night
gold.taskDescription: Establish a recurring weekly family game night that everyone can enjoy consistently.

questions.title: How many people will regularly join game night?
questions.description: Understand the group size to plan games, seating, and snacks appropriately.

questions.title: What ages are the family members participating?
questions.description: Identify the age range to ensure game and activity choices are suitable for everyone.

questions.title: Which day of the week works best for everyone?
questions.description: Pin down a consistent weekday or weekend slot that fits the family schedule.

questions.title: Do you already own games or need to buy some?
questions.description: Assess the current game inventory to determine if purchasing new games is needed.

questions.title: What is your budget for games and supplies?
questions.description: Establish a spending limit to guide recommendations for games, snacks, and materials.

questions.title: Where in your home will game night take place?
questions.description: Identify the physical space to plan for seating, table size, and setup needs.

questions.title: Should game night include snacks or a themed experience?
questions.description: Determine whether food, themes, or special touches are part of the vision for the event.
